pixel_to_world — MEASURE1D scale op

• Data kinds: measurement → measurement

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.pixel_to_world(value_px, mm_per_px) (to call the implementation directly, import measuring1d; measuring1d.pixel_to_world(value_px, mm_per_px); from the registry, opsmeasure1d.get("pixel_to_world"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Converts one length measured in pixels to real-world mm (value_px * mm_per_px).

Pass a mm_per_px that was measured with mm_per_px_from_reference. value_px may be zero or negative (differences and biases convert as they are) but must be finite; mm_per_px must be finite and positive. Otherwise ValueError. Returns a float (measurement sort). For areas, square mm/px and multiply yourself (this op handles lengths only).
